_comment: Clients: how often the bodies of other players, soldiers and civilians are posed (animation, aim, hands on the gun). Your own body is always posed every frame. Closer than near_distance metres and in view: every frame. Up to far_distance: mid_rate times a second. Further: far_rate. Out of view at any distance: off_screen_rate (their shadows can still show). A scope's zoom counts as coming closer. A body is in view while any of a ball of view_radius metres around its middle is.
